inApp.method: Chrome, production build; 30 frames, azimuth +0.02° per frame (about 0.15 CSS px at 14 mm), 400x300 CSS px around the Perseid radiant at 2026-08-13 00:30. symbolEnergyCV: frame-to-frame variation of the radiant symbol energy with density off; popFraction: share of lit pixels changing by more than 60 between consecutive frames with density on. Before = aligned 2-hour build index-2YCVIHbv.js, after = whole-night build index-BnWrjiWA.js; the meteor samples differ, the symbol does not.
